Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int \frac{1}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "5a88e33b-bcc9-5d5e-854e-716b08caf25b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|4 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{1}{4}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{1}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "5a88e33b-bcc9-5d5e-854e-716b08caf25b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "5a88e33b-bcc9-5d5e-854e-716b08caf25b" :question/answer-fields "dd581dc8-7072-5e17-a1d9-7722221a47a2"] [:db/ensure "5a88e33b-bcc9-5d5e-854e-716b08caf25b" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064250 :knowledge-point/questions "5a88e33b-bcc9-5d5e-854e-716b08caf25b"] [:db/add "ee416b02-f6d8-5944-80fd-be5c1139ab5b" :answer/id #uuid "ee416b02-f6d8-5944-80fd-be5c1139ab5b"] [:db/add "ee416b02-f6d8-5944-80fd-be5c1139ab5b" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "ee416b02-f6d8-5944-80fd-be5c1139ab5b" :answer/value "\frac{3}{16}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - "bacbded8-6884-5d02-af40-16c8adf1cd96" :question/id #uuid "bacbded8-6884-5d02-af40-16c8adf1cd96"] [:db/add "bacbded8-6884-5d02-af40-16c8adf1cd96" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{4}{5}$.

$$

$$

$$
\frac{4}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{4}{5}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{4}{5}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "bacbded8-6884-5d02-af40-16c8adf1cd96" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "bacbded8-6884-5d02-af40-16c8adf1cd96" :question/answer-fields "cbfeac20-e0ab-547c-9174-31fab0729907" :question/id #uuid "cbfeac20-e0ab-547c-9174-31fab0729907"] [:db/add "cbfeac20-e0ab-547c-9174-31fab0729907" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "cbfeac20-e0ab-547c-9174-31fab0729907" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Because $4>0$, $|u|=4|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/4$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $12\cdot \frac{1}{4}=3$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "cbfeac20-e0ab-547c-9174-31fab0729907" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "cbfeac20-e0ab-547c-9174-31fab0729907" :question/answer-fields "049adf91-8527-55f1-a6ee-6f90fabbcdd7" :question/id #uuid "049adf91-8527-55f1-a6ee-6f90fabbcdd7"] [:db/add "049adf91-8527-55f1-a6ee-6f90fabbcdd7" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Because $5>0$, $|u|=5|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/5$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $10\cdot \frac{1}{5}=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "049adf91-8527-55f1-a6ee-6f90fabbcdd7" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "049adf91-8527-55f1-a6ee-6f90fabbcdd7" :question/answer-fields Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Because $3>0$, $|u|=3|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/3$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $12\cdot \frac{1}{3}=4$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}+C.

"7557536f-4126-5553-aa32-304478d3cfce" :question/id #uuid "7557536f-4126-5553-aa32-304478d3cfce"] [:db/add "7557536f-4126-5553-aa32-304478d3cfce" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|4 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3}{4}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{3}{4}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "7557536f-4126-5553-aa32-304478d3cfce" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "7557536f-4126-5553-aa32-304478d3cfce" :question/answer-fields "8200acbd-0096-5a04-af42-dd11117a204a" :question/id #uuid "8200acbd-0096-5a04-af42-dd11117a204a"] [:db/add "8200acbd-0096-5a04-af42-dd11117a204a" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

\int \frac{2}{|3 x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x

$$
\frac{2}{3}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{2}{3}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

"f1f49f83-41db-5881-9619-52564f75d31c" :question/id #uuid "f1f49f83-41db-5881-9619-52564f75d31c"] [:db/add "f1f49f83-41db-5881-9619-52564f75d31c" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x

$$

$$

$$

"fd18704b-c686-54f7-9804-c8dbf31969bd" :question/id #uuid "fd18704b-c686-54f7-9804-c8dbf31969bd"] [:db/add "fd18704b-c686-54f7-9804-c8dbf31969bd" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Because $2>0$, $|u|=2|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/2$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{2}=1$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "fd18704b-c686-54f7-9804-c8dbf31969bd" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "fd18704b-c686-54f7-9804-c8dbf31969bd" :question/answer-fields "491e4c26-a08b-53a0-9c8a-2f14d053b450" :question/id #uuid "491e4c26-a08b-53a0-9c8a-2f14d053b450"] [:db/add "491e4c26-a08b-53a0-9c8a-2f14d053b450" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x

Because $5>0$, $|u|=5|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/5$.

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}\right)+C.

"3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3" :question/id #uuid "3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3"] [:db/add "3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Because $3>0$, $|u|=3|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/3$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $12\cdot \frac{1}{3}=4$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(3 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3" :question/answer-fields $$
\int \frac{3}{|3 x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|3 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{3}=1$.

$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(3 x \right)}+C.
$$"] ["0a802c2b-6d44-5e3b-8524-69c4811ecad9" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["0a802c2b-6d44-5e3b-8524-69c4811ecad9" :question/answer-fields "ecf22287-e7ac-53c6-b876-fd2048726cd4"] $$
\int \frac{2}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{1}{2}$.

$$

$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

$$"] ["40b27085-34e6-58d6-ab38-f796eb2eb64b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["40b27085-34e6-58d6-ab38-f796eb2eb64b" :question/answer-fields "021c7d86-f00a-57fa-8bfe-7262334eefe1"] ["5a4cf722-3932-5fb6-8d70-364a496ddcfb" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["5a4cf722-3932-5fb6-8d70-364a496ddcfb" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|5 x|>1$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{3}{5}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{3}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3}{5}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{3}{5}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] ["5a4cf722-3932-5fb6-8d70-364a496ddcfb" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["5a4cf722-3932-5fb6-8d70-364a496ddcfb" :question/answer-fields "7f0fef05-ab2a-5429-9f3b-e358d19bd9af"] :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

\int \frac{2}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected real interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Because $3>0$, $|u|=3|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/3$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $6\cdot \frac{1}{3}=2$.

$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$

:question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["e5ce8791-8926-5237-bce9-217f5aba6353" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Because $4>0$, $|u|=4|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/4$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $16\cdot \frac{1}{4}=4$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] ["e5ce8791-8926-5237-bce9-217f5aba6353" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] ["e5ce8791-8926-5237-bce9-217f5aba6353" :question/answer-fields "36c808c4-9944-51f4-b5ac-8ea1b7b7854e"] :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Work on a connected interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work on a connected real interval where $|3 x|>1$.

Because $3>0$, $|u|=3|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/3$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $12\cdot \frac{1}{3}=4$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|x|\sqrt{9 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
4\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(3 x \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] ["3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] ["3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3" :question/answer-fields "cc51aeb5-0fb5-5a82-b880-19e13eb7f666"] [17592186064250 :knowledge-point/questions "3dcd0af0-2803-535c-b276-8eb7fdad5da3"] ["generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "1fb53caa-df0e-5c70-9c5b-f0d19d4416b4"] ["generator" :question-generator/script "generators/38/3863ea472908f17e1f0524d241f4c90b18b0bfe707b9a6d2914db21b43cc6db3/generator.py"] [17592186064250 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] [17592186678939 :question/retired true] [17592186678946 :question/retired true] [17592186678964 :question/retired true] [17592186678974 :question/retired true] [17592186678978 :question/retired true] [17592186678988 :question/retired true] [17592186679003 :question/retired true] [17592186679016 :question/retired true] [17592186679018 :question/retired true] [17592186679020 :question/retired true] [17592186679032 :question/retired true] [17592186679034 :question/retired true] [17592186679052 :question/retired true] [17592186679060 :question/retired true] [17592186679061 :question/retired true] [17592186679063 :question/retired true] [17592186679065 :question/retired true] [17592186679070 :question/retired true] [17592186679081 :question/retired true] [17592186679082 :question/retired true] [17592186679083 :question/retired true] [17592186679091 :question/retired true] [17592186679092 :question/retired true] [17592186679095 :question/retired true]] "retractions" [[17592186064250 :knowledge-point/question-generator 17592186679105]]}
